resources.string: Detects which app is in the foreground. If it is a distracting app you chose, a deep-breathing screen appears first, and you get another reminder after using it for a while. In browsers, only the URL in the address bar is read, to recognise the websites you chose. Nothing else on screen is ever read, and all data stays on this phone — nothing is uploaded.
Take a few deep breaths before opening a distracting app. You can still open it if you want to.

Start by creating a group, such as “Social”, and add Instagram and Threads to it. From then on, you’ll take a breath before opening them.
Accessibility is on. You’ll take a breath before opening the apps in your groups.
Without this permission, One Breath can’t tell which app you opened, so no reminders will appear. Tap the button below → Installed apps → One Breath → turn it on.
Sort distracting apps into groups, and choose which reminders each group gets.
A group is a set of apps you want reminders for — for example, “Social” with Instagram and Threads, or “Video” with YouTube and Netflix.
Each group decides for itself: whether to take a breath before opening, whether to check in after a while, and whether to remind you when you open their websites in a browser.

Groups without their own timing use these settings.
How long the breathing screen waits before you can choose “Continue”. 0 = no wait.
After you choose Continue, reopening the same app during this time won’t be interrupted.
While you stay in the same app, you’ll be asked this often whether you want to keep going.
How long the in-use reminder screen waits before you can choose to keep going. 0 = no wait.
No internet permission, no ads. All settings and counts stay on this phone and are never sent anywhere.

The accessibility permission is only used to know which app is in the foreground. To recognise the websites you chose, only the URL in a browser’s address bar is read — nothing else on screen is ever read.
In your phone’s Settings → Battery → One Breath, set it to “Unrestricted” so battery saving doesn’t shut it down and reminders don’t suddenly stop working.
Turn off to pause everything. Your groups and settings are kept.
